description: This Java interface defines the structure and components for representing and constructing topic paths used in the Ditto Protocol, including enums for path parts and static methods for builder creation.

classes.name: TopicPath
classes.description: Interface representing a topic path with methods to retrieve its components, enums for path parts, and static factory methods.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the topic path.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group part (enum) of the topic path.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel part (enum) of the topic path.

methods.name: getCriterion
methods.description: Returns the criterion part (enum) of the topic path.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the action part of the topic path.

methods.name: getSearchAction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the search action part of the topic path.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns an Optional subject string of the topic path.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name part of the topic path.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the full path string of the topic path.

methods.name: isWildcardTopic
methods.description: Returns true if the ID is a wildcard placeholder.
